data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: implementation-plan SKILL.md has no phase-coverage assertion logic on HEAD. Classification: COMPLEX — requires (a) defining a reliable 'named-phase pattern' parser in an LLM instruction file (non-trivial heuristics for 'SPLIT/PUBLISH phase' vs ordinary prose); (b) new manifest contract between implementation-plan and completion-verifier; (c) behavioral test. Recommend creating an epic to scope the phase-detection heuristic and manifest schema before implementing. Leaving OPEN.
